args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- Please treat the old Covey & Lark name as the same account and update the saved report label to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti
(drafted with Bettina Kroll)

args.text: Bettina, I've saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's in Drafts for someone to review and send. It has Sofia's three bullets plus your two: Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I signed it from Sofia and noted that you helped draft it, so change that if you want.
